name: Algo Four XL
notes: DX100 panel; operators use four pickers (card limit). POLY/MONO is voice count (8/1): Selectors cannot set it. LFO SPEED is 0.02–40 Hz, not 0.0008–55; its range control is hidden. D2R zero cannot hold D1L from this card (linked level hidden). Bend Low/High needs allocator outputs. Main lacks breath/foot CC inputs: aftertouch/FX stand in. Ratio uses semitones, detune cents, bend octaves. Cartridge, MIDI settings and stored patch memory are hardware/storage, not reproduced.
